files.name: dochi_minigames-0.1.2-fabric-1.21.1.jar
files.html:
0.1.2 Change Log

  • Added a coin toss to determine who goes first in MWENT. AI battles now use a Villager entity as a fallback when no NPC is available.
  • Added an in-game tutorial for MWENT.
  • Fixed a background rendering bug affecting MWENT card items.
  • Optimized MWENT's PvP system and overall performance.
